Metadata.Title: RHSA-2025:10364: webkitgtk4 security update (Important)

Platforms: Red Hat Enterprise Linux 7 Extended Lifecycle Support

Metadata.Description:
WebKitGTK+ is port of the WebKit portable web rendering engine to the GTK+ platform. These packages provide WebKitGTK+ for GTK+ 3.
